KIRLOSKAR BROTHERS LIMITED
About Kirloskar Brothers Limited
Kirloskar Brothers Limited (KBL) is a world-class pump manufacturing company 
with expertise in engineering and manufacture of systems for fluid management 
established in 1888 and incorporated in 1920. 
As the market leader in fluid 
management, KBL provides complete fluid management solutions for large 
infrastructure projects in the areas of water supply, power plants, irrigation, oil & 
gas and marine & defence. KBL engineers and manufactures industrial, agriculture 
& domestic pumps, valves and hydro turbines. KBL is the only pump 
manufacturing company in India and ninth in the world to be accredited with the N 
and NPT certification by the American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME).
For further information, please visit www.kirloskarpumps.com
